result.summary: The intersection features marked zebra crosswalks and pedestrian signals, but the wide roadway and lack of physical protection like medians increase exposure. Commercial land use and multiple travel lanes suggest a high-volume environment where pedestrians must cross several lanes of traffic at once.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A vehicle on the left side of the image is positioned near the crosswalk, potentially blocking sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility.

result.summary: The intersection features a marked zebra crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides, but the wide roadway and lack of a median increase pedestrian exposure. Visible pavement degradation and parked vehicles near the crossing create potential hazards for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: A large, uneven patch in the roadway surface is located directly in front of the crosswalk, posing a trip hazard or affecting vehicle control.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground, just before the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked trucks and vehicles near the intersection corners may block the view between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right sides of the intersection.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines.

result.summary: The intersection features a high-visibility zebra crosswalk and curb ramps, providing basic pedestrian infrastructure. However, the wide roadway creates a long unprotected crossing distance, and a large van parked near the crossing on the right creates a significant visual obstruction.

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with marked zebra crosswalks, sidewalks, and traffic signals, providing basic pedestrian infrastructure. However, the wide roadway and presence of parked vehicles near the corners create visibility challenges and increase exposure time for pedestrians.
